title: One release-note block for the whole product with one label: a desktop: PR line is Desktop only, shown as a badge on the changelog page; the shipped notes carry no label
steps: S1: Run node --test on packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/collect-release-notes.test.mjs (the release-note block, the old desktop-release-note block, both in one PR, the desktop: prefix, a foreign label, the PR template).

S2: Run node --test on packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/draft-release-notes.test.mjs and release-notes-page.test.mjs (badge on the drafted page, prefix in the shipped notes, label rules on the page, the hash the docs host must match).
S3: Run node --test on apps/tracy-docs/test/changelog-desktop.test.mjs (committed pages, 0.5 marks Desktop only changes, a foreign label on a page fails).
expect: S1: lines of a release-note block and of an old desktop-release-note block in the same PR are both read, NONE dropped; 'Desktop:   x' and '- DESKTOP:x' become 'desktop: x' and '- desktop: x'; 'web: …' is rejected while 'Mac: now needs macOS 13 or later.' is kept; the PR template ships ```release-note with NONE, mentions desktop:, and no longer ships the old block.

S2: a 'desktop:' PR line drafts as '- <text> _(Desktop only)_' in Highlights, Changes and a patch section, an unlabelled line as a plain bullet; releaseNotesFromPage drops the badge and returns plain '- <text>' (no 'desktop:', no 'Desktop only'); docsServeNotes matches the sha256 of the plain notes and not of the badged text; a page bullet with 'desktop:', 'web:', 'mobile:', '_(Web only)_' or a badge that is not at the end of the bullet is a problem.

S3: every committed page passes; 0.5.md has at least one Desktop only line and its Highlights ship as plain text with no 'desktop:' and no 'Desktop only'; a copy with '- web: …' or '_(Web only)_' fails; the index says every change people see, on the web and in the desktop app, Desktop only marked.

selectors.pr_block: ```release-note … ``` in the PR body (old name ```desktop-release-note``` still read)
selectors.page_badge: ' _(Desktop only)_' at the end of a bullet in apps/tracy-docs/src/content/docs/changelog/desktop/<X.Y>.md
selectors.shipped_notes: the feed's releaseNotes and Resources/release-notes.txt: plain bullets, no label

fence: one label only: desktop: in PR notes, _(Desktop only)_ at the end of a page bullet; any other label is refused; the notes a release ships and their hash carry no label at all

tests: the release-note block gives one line per change, web or desktop
a PR carrying both the old desktop-release-note block and the new one gives the lines of both
the desktop: prefix is written one way whatever case or spacing the author used
a label other than desktop: is refused, while a capitalised word before a colon is just prose
the PR template ships the release-note block (not the old name), defaulting to NONE
a desktop: line drafts as a Desktop only bullet, an unlabelled one as a plain bullet, and both ship as plain text
a patch section drafts its Desktop only lines with the badge too
a Desktop only line ships as plain text: the label is for the web page only, never in the notes an app shows
the docs host serving a labelled page matches the hash of the clean notes the candidate froze
the page carries one label, as the badge at the end of a bullet: no prefix, no other label
a page line with a label other than the one Desktop only badge is refused
0.5 marks its Desktop only changes, and its Highlights ship them as plain text, with no label
